Hi Priya —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier today. Quick recap: CedarWave is aiming to reduce per-request inference cost for your batch clinical-report generation pipeline and to get stable p99 latency under 300ms for your interactive clinician UI. We also noted regulatory constraints around audit logs and VPC connectivity for PHI.

Next recommended step: a 60–90 minute technical deep dive where our ML infra and serving engineers can map your pipeline to Redwood’s runtime and validate integration requirements (VPC peering, KMS, model quantization tradeoffs).

- Confirm traffic patterns and SLO targets (p50/p95/p99)
- Walk the current model architecture and tokenizer/sequence length distributions
- Review network/security requirements and audit/logging needs
- Draft an initial rollout plan and gating criteria

Availability — pick up to two slots that work for your technical team:
- Tue May 18: 10:00–11:30 PT (preferred)
- Wed May 19: 14:00–15:30 PT
- Thu May 20: 09:00–10:30 PT

Please confirm who from CedarWave should attend (ML lead, infra/ops, security/compliance). We’ll ask: one ML engineer, one infra/sre, and optionally your security lead. I’ve attached a draft agenda and the discovery notes from today for reference.

If those slots don’t work, tell me a couple of alternatives and we’ll triage.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the team aligned.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Solutions
